known.via: English Wikipedia "Txakoli de Álava" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Basque Country appellation in the province of Álava, around Amurrio and Llodio, for txakoli, a thin, acidic white wine that can be naturally fizzy. It is traditionally poured from a height into the glass, like cider.
